description: What Dependabot updated (pub in console/, NuGet in status/, the workflow actions), plus the images and tools pinned in yggdrasil.yml, ci/*.sh and the Dockerfiles (every FROM is pinned by version and digest: status/, console/, platform/jenkins/). The docker-compose manager is left out, as dependabot.yml left docker out: the platform images in platform/compose.yml are moved by hand.

packageRules.description: pub, NuGet and the workflow actions weekly, as Dependabot did (the preset has actions monthly).
The workflow actions in one pull request, as Dependabot grouped them.
templates/ are examples copied into other repositories: Dependabot never updated their pins, and they change by hand.
